name: projectflow-codex
description: Codex session tracking for ProjectFlow projects

interface.shortDescription: Sync Codex work sessions into ProjectFlow.
interface.longDescription: ProjectFlow Codex links local repositories to ProjectFlow projects, starts sessions, records checkpoints with touched files and validation status, and creates follow-up tasks when Codex discovers additional work.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ProjectFlow Codex to sync this coding session.
